message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: a person (吴某) wants to get contract for construction of residential building for workers, without public bidding, by bribing officials (谭某, 李某, 胡某). He pays them cash (3万, 2万). This is bribery: giving money to state staff for favorable treatment. The crime is "受贿" (bribery) but from the perspective of the bribe giver, it's "行贿". In Chinese criminal law, giving bribes is "行贿罪". The examples: earlier case with 金某 gave bribes to hospital director, answer: 行贿. So here it's also 行贿. Also possibly "非法获取工程承包" but main is 行贿. So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.
